introduction: This spec adds a second way to build the sandbox provider that specs 25–28 already use: with `[sandbox].provider = "gateway"`, hub dials a remote agentkit-gateway under one hub-held token, probes it at start, snapshots its capabilities and runs its own lease-enforcing gateway in front of it. Callers keep the same API, leases and guarantees and never see the remote gateway's address or token.

glossary.capability snapshot: The single `Capabilities()` value hub reads from the remote client after a successful probe and keeps for the life of the process.
glossary.gateway factory: The gateway variant of spec 25's provider factory seam; production uses `gateway.Dial`, tests inject a client pointing at an in-process remote.
glossary.hub gateway: Hub's own embedded `gatewayd.Server` on `[sandbox].listen` (spec 27), which authenticates lease tokens; its URL is the lease's `gateway_url`.
glossary.loopback host: `localhost` or a loopback IP literal, decided without a DNS lookup (spec 27's rule).
glossary.redacting value: The type hub stores the validated token in, whose fmt, slog and JSON renderings are all `[redacted]`.
glossary.remote client: The `sandbox.Provider` returned by `gateway.Dial(gateway_url, gateway.Options{Token: gateway_token})` (or a test-injected equivalent) that hub uses as its provider.
glossary.remote gateway: The deployment's agentkit-gateway that hub reaches at the configured `sandbox.gateway_url` and that runs the boxes on its own backend.
glossary.remote refusal: A remote call that fails with gRPC status `Unauthenticated` or `PermissionDenied` because the remote gateway rejected hub's token.
glossary.scrub set: The values spec 27's scrubber replaces with `[redacted]` in provider error text (27-REQ-9.1); for the gateway provider it also holds the token, the `gateway_url` string and the URL's `url.Host`.

requirements.title: Selecting the remote provider
requirements.rationale: The source PRD asks for one API over either a host engine or a remote agentkit-gateway, chosen per deployment.

criteria.condition: hub starts with `provider = "gateway"`, a valid `gateway_url` and `gateway_token`, and a reachable remote gateway that accepts the token
criteria.action: return a running sandbox service whose `Provider()` is the remote client
criteria.contract: `Init` returns a non-nil `*Service` and a nil error; hub proceeds to bind its listeners

criteria.condition: `[sandbox].provider` is set to a value other than `"podman"` or `"gateway"`
criteria.action: refuse start with a static failure that names `sandbox.provider` and lists both `podman` and `gateway` as accepted values
criteria.contract: `Validate` returns a joined error containing `sandbox.provider`, `podman` and `gateway`; no provider factory is called

criteria.condition: `provider = "gateway"` is configured
criteria.action: build no Podman provider and execute no engine binary at any point in the process
criteria.contract: the Podman provider factory is called zero times and no child process is started

criteria.action: apply spec 25's profile rules, `max_ttl`, `network_modes`, scope, profile-listing and disabled-state behaviour identically for `provider = "gateway"` and `provider = "podman"`
criteria.contract: a profile set accepted or rejected under podman is accepted or rejected with the same message under gateway, given the same provider capabilities

requirements.title: Validating gateway_url
requirements.rationale: The token grants access to every box hub runs, so the address must be unambiguous and must not carry credentials or travel in plaintext over a network.

criteria.action: recognise `sandbox.gateway_url` and `sandbox.gateway_token` as known keys, expand `${NAME}` in both like every other string, and validate both together with the other static checks before any provider is built
criteria.contract: neither key is reported as unknown; all static failures, including these keys', arrive in one `errors.Join` error

criteria.condition: `provider = "gateway"` and `gateway_url` is absent or empty after expansion
criteria.action: refuse start with a static failure naming `sandbox.gateway_url` and stating that it is required
criteria.contract: joined error contains `sandbox.gateway_url` and `required`

criteria.condition: `gateway_url` does not parse as an absolute URL, or its scheme is neither `https` nor `http` with a loopback host
criteria.action: refuse start with a static failure naming `sandbox.gateway_url` and the scheme or parse rule it broke
criteria.contract: joined error contains `sandbox.gateway_url`; `http://127.0.0.1:9000` and `http://localhost:9000` and `https://gw.example:443` pass, `http://gw.example:9000` and `ftp://127.0.0.1` fail

criteria.condition: `gateway_url` has an empty host, or a port that is non-numeric or outside 1 to 65535
criteria.action: refuse start with a static failure naming `sandbox.gateway_url` and the host or port rule it broke
criteria.contract: joined error contains `sandbox.gateway_url`; ports 1 and 65535 pass, ports 0 and 65536 fail

criteria.condition: `gateway_url` carries userinfo, a query, a fragment, or a path other than empty or `/`
criteria.action: refuse start with a static failure naming `sandbox.gateway_url` and the rule it broke
criteria.contract: joined error contains `sandbox.gateway_url`; `https://gw.example/` passes, `https://gw.example/api`, `https://gw.example?x=1` and `https://gw.example#f` fail

criteria.action: remove any userinfo from `gateway_url` before quoting it in any failure message
criteria.contract: for `https://user:pw@gw.example`, the error contains neither `user:pw` nor `pw@`

requirements.title: Validating gateway_token
requirements.rationale: gRPC metadata accepts only printable ASCII, trailing newlines from secret files are common, and a short token is weak and would make scrubbing mangle ordinary text.

criteria.condition: `provider = "gateway"` and `gateway_token` is absent or empty after `${NAME}` expansion
criteria.action: refuse start with a static failure naming `sandbox.gateway_token` and stating that it is required
criteria.contract: joined error contains `sandbox.gateway_token` and `required`

criteria.condition: `gateway_token` is shorter than 16 characters
criteria.action: refuse start with a static failure naming `sandbox.gateway_token` and the minimum length of 16
criteria.contract: a 15-character token fails, a 16-character token passes

criteria.condition: `gateway_token` contains any byte outside 0x21–0x7E, including a space or a trailing newline
criteria.action: refuse start with a static failure naming `sandbox.gateway_token` and the printable-ASCII-without-spaces rule
criteria.contract: joined error contains `sandbox.gateway_token`; a token of 16 valid characters plus `\n` fails

criteria.action: for any `gateway_token` value, valid or invalid, produce validation error text that contains neither the token nor any contiguous substring of it of 8 or more characters
criteria.contract: property test over generated tokens: `strings.Contains(err.Error(), sub)` is false for every such substring

requirements.title: Refusing the other provider's keys
requirements.rationale: A silently ignored `runtime` or `userns` under a remote provider would make an operator believe in isolation that does not exist.

criteria.condition: `provider = "gateway"` and any of `engine_binary`, `runtime` or `userns` is non-empty
criteria.action: refuse start with one static failure per such key, naming the key and stating it applies only to provider `"podman"`
criteria.contract: joined error contains e.g. `sandbox.runtime` and `podman`

criteria.condition: `provider = "podman"` and `gateway_url` or `gateway_token` is non-empty
criteria.action: refuse start with one static failure per such key, naming the key and stating it applies only to provider `"gateway"`, without echoing the token value
criteria.contract: joined error contains `sandbox.gateway_token` and `gateway` and does not contain the configured token

criteria.action: collect other-provider key failures in the same joined error as every other static failure
criteria.contract: a config with an other-provider key and an invalid `max_ttl` yields one error that names both keys

requirements.title: Building and probing the remote client
requirements.rationale: The probe proves at start that the remote is reachable and accepts hub's token without creating anything.

criteria.condition: static validation passes with `provider = "gateway"`
criteria.action: build the remote client by calling the gateway factory once with the validated `gateway_url` and `gateway_token`; the production factory calls `gateway.Dial(gateway_url, gateway.Options{Token: gateway_token})`
criteria.contract: the gateway factory receives exactly the configured URL and token

criteria.condition: the remote client has been built
criteria.action: probe it with exactly one `List` call under a 10-second timeout and make no `Create` or `Destroy` call on the remote during start
criteria.contract: a recording remote backend observes 1 List, 0 Create and 0 Destroy calls under hub's token after start

criteria.condition: static validation fails
criteria.action: return the static failures without calling the gateway factory or issuing any `List`
criteria.contract: the injected gateway factory is called 0 times; `Start` returns the joined static error

criteria.condition: the gateway factory returns an error, or the probe fails because the remote is unreachable, a TLS failure occurs, the remote refuses the token, or the 10-second timeout expires
criteria.action: refuse start with an error that starts with `sandbox:`, names `sandbox.provider`, `sandbox.gateway_url` and `sandbox.gateway_token`, and includes the client's error text with the token replaced by `[redacted]` and URL userinfo removed
criteria.contract: `Init` returns a non-nil error and a nil service; the error text contains the three key names and not the token

criteria.condition: the remote accepts the connection but does not answer the probe `List`
criteria.action: abandon the probe when the 10-second timeout expires and refuse start as in 29-REQ-5.4
criteria.contract: `Init` returns an error no later than 10 seconds plus 1 second after the probe began

requirements.title: Remote capability snapshot
requirements.rationale: The assumed `Capabilities()` takes no context and returns no error, so reading the remote on every call could block hub's gateway or report empty modes during an outage.

criteria.condition: the probe succeeds
criteria.action: read the remote client's `Capabilities()` exactly once and keep that snapshot for the life of the process
criteria.contract: the remote client's `Capabilities()` is called once across start-up and any number of later backend `Capabilities()` calls

criteria.condition: a `network_modes` entry is not in the snapshot's `NetworkModes`
criteria.action: refuse start with the message of 25-REQ-5.4 unchanged
criteria.contract: `Init` returns that error and no service

criteria.condition: `sandbox.CheckSpec` rejects a profile's spec against the snapshot
criteria.action: refuse start with the per-profile message of 25-REQ-5.5 to 25-REQ-5.7 unchanged
criteria.contract: `Init` returns that error and no service

criteria.action: answer `Capabilities()` (27-REQ-7.1) by narrowing the snapshot without any call to the remote, so a change to the remote's capabilities takes effect only after hub restarts
criteria.contract: backend `Capabilities()` returns the narrowed snapshot while the remote is stopped

requirements.title: Lease behaviour over the remote provider
requirements.rationale: Hub's gateway, the lease API and expiry use the remote client through the same `sandbox.Provider` seam, with only three remote-specific behaviours.

criteria.condition: a caller obtains a lease from `POST /api/v1/workspaces/widgets/sandboxes`, calls `gateway.Dial(lease.gateway_url, lease token)` and then `Create(sandbox.Spec{})`
criteria.action: create exactly one box on the remote gateway's backend under hub's token, with the lease's image and TTL and an `Env` equal to the profile's `env` merged with the resolved secrets
criteria.contract: the recording remote backend captures one Spec with the lease's Image, TTL and Env; the caller receives a sandbox handle

criteria.action: send only hub's configured `gateway_token` to the remote and never send a lease token to it, and return a lease `gateway_url` equal to hub's own gateway URL (27-REQ-2.6), never the configured remote `gateway_url`
criteria.contract: the remote authenticator sees only hub's token; the lease representation's `gateway_url` differs from `sandbox.gateway_url`

criteria.condition: a caller issues a second `Create` under the same lease token, or dials hub's gateway with a token hub never minted
criteria.action: refuse the call without contacting the remote
criteria.contract: second Create returns gRPC `FailedPrecondition`; an unminted token returns `Unauthenticated`; the remote records no additional Create

criteria.condition: a client calls `DELETE` on an active lease, or the caller calls `Close` on its sandbox handle
criteria.action: destroy the box on the remote and revoke the lease token
criteria.contract: the remote's `List` no longer contains the box; a later dial with the lease token is `Unauthenticated`

criteria.condition: a destroy through the remote client fails with an error matching `errors.Is(err, sandbox.ErrNotFound)` or with gRPC status `NotFound`
criteria.system: hub gateway backend, DELETE path and expiry sweep
criteria.action: treat the box as destroyed, exactly as spec 27 and spec 28 treat a provider not-found
criteria.contract: the lease ends as it would after a successful destroy; `DELETE` answers its success status, not 502

criteria.condition: a remote call made after start fails with gRPC status `Unauthenticated` or `PermissionDenied`
criteria.action: return the error to the hub gateway caller with code `Unavailable` and the scrubbed message, apply spec 27's lease outcome unchanged, and log exactly one error record that names `sandbox.gateway_token` without its value
criteria.contract: caller sees `codes.Unavailable`; a Create leaves the lease `failed`, a Destroy leaves it `active`, a `DELETE` answers 502; one slog error record per occurrence

criteria.condition: a remote `Create` fails or its response is lost
criteria.action: not retry the remote `Create`
criteria.contract: the remote backend records exactly one Create per caller Create, including failed ones

requirements.title: The remote token and address never leave hub
requirements.rationale: Callers must never see the provider, and the token grants access to every box hub runs.

criteria.condition: `provider = "gateway"` is configured
criteria.action: include in the scrub set of 27-REQ-9.1, besides the secret and `env` values, the token, the configured `gateway_url` string and the URL's `url.Host`
criteria.contract: scrubbing a text containing any of the three yields `[redacted]` in its place

criteria.condition: the remote backend returns an error whose text contains hub's remote token and the remote host
criteria.action: keep both values out of every lease representation, HTTP response body, audit event, log line, gateway error message and lease `error` field
criteria.contract: none of the captured outputs contains the token or the remote host string

criteria.action: exclude the token from every HTTP response including the profile listing and error bodies, every metric label, and the start-up info record, whose attributes remain exactly `provider` and `profiles` (25-REQ-8.2)
criteria.contract: the start-up info record has attributes {provider, profiles} only; `/metrics` and the profile listing do not contain the token

criteria.action: render the validated token as `[redacted]` under `%v`, `%+v`, `%#v`, `%s`, `slog` and `json.Marshal`, including when it is a field of a printed struct
criteria.contract: each rendering of a struct holding the token contains `[redacted]` and not the token

criteria.action: for any start-up error produced under 29-REQ-2 to 29-REQ-6, contain no occurrence of the token and quote `gateway_url` only with its userinfo removed
criteria.contract: property test over generated configs and probe failures: the error text never contains the token or userinfo

requirements.title: Remote outages and shutdown
requirements.rationale: Hub relies on the gateway client's own reconnection and must report outages as recorded, visible outcomes.

criteria.condition: the remote gateway cannot be reached
criteria.action: keep issuing leases and listing profiles, since neither calls the provider
criteria.contract: `POST /api/v1/workspaces/{ws}/sandboxes` returns its success status and the profile listing returns 200

criteria.condition: a caller's `Create` reaches hub's gateway while the remote is unreachable
criteria.action: mark the lease `failed` with the scrubbed provider error (27-REQ-6.3)
criteria.contract: the caller receives an error; the lease's state is `failed` and its `error` field is scrubbed

criteria.condition: a client sends `DELETE` for an `active` lease while the remote is unreachable
criteria.action: change nothing about the lease
criteria.contract: HTTP 502 with error code `sandbox_provider_error`; the lease stays `active` and its token stays valid

criteria.condition: a caller calls `Close` on its sandbox handle while the remote is unreachable
criteria.action: leave the lease `active`
criteria.contract: `Close` returns a non-nil error; the lease state is `active`

criteria.condition: the expiry sweep tries to destroy a box while the remote is unreachable
criteria.action: log the failure and try the same lease again on its next run
criteria.contract: one warning or error log per failed destroy; the lease is destroyed on the first run after the remote returns

criteria.condition: the remote gateway restarts on the same address after being down
criteria.action: succeed on the next provider call without hub restarting and without hub redialling or building a new client
criteria.contract: the next lease's `Create` returns a sandbox; the gateway factory call count stays 1

criteria.condition: hub shuts down with `provider = "gateway"`
criteria.action: close the remote client, if it implements `io.Closer`, only after spec 28's shutdown step has finished destroying active boxes
criteria.contract: `Close` on the client is called once, after the last shutdown Destroy; a client without `Close` causes no error

requirements.title: Build isolation
requirements.rationale: The `afc` CLI must stay free of the sandbox and gRPC dependency tree that this spec's dial code pulls in.

criteria.action: depend on no agentkit-go, `google.golang.org/grpc` or `internal/sandboxes` package after this spec's `gateway.Dial` dependency is added
criteria.contract: `go list -deps ./cmd/afc` output contains none of those import paths (TS-25-54 stays green)

execution_paths.title: Operator starts hub against a remote agentkit-gateway

steps.action: starts af-hub with `provider = "gateway"`, `gateway_url = "http://127.0.0.1:<port>"` and `gateway_token = "${AGENTKIT_GATEWAY_TOKEN}"`
expands and validates the keys and wraps the token in the redacting value
builds the remote client through the gateway factory and issues one `List` under a 10-second timeout
authenticates hub's token and answers the `List`
reads and keeps the capability snapshot, checks `network_modes` and every profile, and logs one info record with `provider` and `profiles`
binds hub's gateway and the HTTP server

execution_paths.title: Agent leases a box that runs on the remote gateway and deletes it

steps.action: sends `POST /api/v1/workspaces/widgets/sandboxes` and receives a lease whose `gateway_url` is hub's gateway
calls `gateway.Dial(lease.gateway_url, token)` and `Create(sandbox.Spec{})`
builds the spec from the lease and profile, adds resolved secrets, and calls `Create` on the remote client under hub's token
creates the box on its backend with the lease's image, TTL and env
sends `DELETE` for the lease
destroys the box through the remote client and revokes the lease token; the remote's `List` no longer contains the box

execution_paths.title: Remote backend error carrying hub's token is scrubbed

steps.action: obtains a lease and calls `Create` through hub's gateway
fails the create with an error text containing hub's remote token and the remote host
scrubs the text with the scrub set that includes the token, `gateway_url` and host
marks the lease `failed` with the scrubbed `error` field and emits the audit event
receives a gateway error and reads the lease over HTTP, neither of which contains the token or host

execution_paths.title: Remote outage and recovery on the same address

steps.action: shuts down
obtains a lease and calls `Create` through hub's gateway
fails the remote call and marks the lease `failed` with the scrubbed error
starts again on the same `127.0.0.1:<port>`
obtains a new lease and calls `Create`, which creates a box on the remote without hub restarting

execution_paths.title: Hub shuts down and closes the remote client

steps.action: stops af-hub while a lease is active
destroys every active box through the remote client
closes the remote client because it implements `io.Closer`
